purpose: Test additional rule-specific Reddit/YouTube XAUUSD strategies discovered after v1.2 was already frozen, without modifying earlier experiments.

reddit_london_orb_ema_retest_engulfing.source_basis: Reddit XAUUSD post reporting 100+ trades across about seven months: London opening range breakout, EMA direction filter, no first-break entry, wait for retest and engulfing confirmation.
reddit_london_orb_ema_retest_engulfing.mechanical_status: proxy because source did not disclose EMA period, ORB duration or exit rule

reddit_vwap_wick_touch_continuation.source_basis: Reddit 5m VWAP strategy reportedly backtested about one year: wick touches daily/weekly VWAP, candle opens and closes same side, first valid setup of day, stop-order style continuation entry.
reddit_vwap_wick_touch_continuation.mechanical_status: fixed-horizon proxy; source stop-band and exact Asian-target execution not fully specified

reddit_bollinger_rsi50_recovery.source_basis: Reddit gold system: lower/upper Bollinger-band touch followed by RSI recovery back toward 50, with optional SMA momentum context.

reddit_h4_bb_rsi_divergence.source_basis: Recent Reddit gold setup: H4 RSI divergence combined with roughly 20-day Bollinger extension/squeeze; entry after two-standard-deviation extension and three-candle divergence.

youtube_rsi_divergence_range_reentry.source_basis: YouTube RSI Divergence (GOLD) strategy: divergence alone is not entry; wait for RSI to re-enter the 30-70 range and align with momentum.
youtube_rsi_divergence_range_reentry.mechanical_status: mechanical interpretation of publicly described process

youtube_vwap_momentum_retest.source_basis: YouTube XAUUSD VWAP playbook: momentum mode uses VWAP break and retest, with previous-day levels and ATR context.

youtube_vwap_extreme_mean_reversion.source_basis: Same YouTube playbook mean-reversion mode: fade extensions from VWAP/anchored average with ATR-sized distance.
